content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

At its core, a digital product store without KYC payments enables creators to retain full control over their sales and customer relationships. By utilizing blockchain technology and automatic payment processors like NOWPayments, creators can sell digital goods while avoiding traditional banking restrictions. This matters because it democratizes access to global markets, allowing creators from regions with limited payment options to effectively monetize their work without exorbitant fees or compliance hurdles.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC digital product store hinges on a combination of free and open-source tools. For instance, hosting can be achieved using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing a robust platform for your storefront. The backend processes are managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle payment verification via NOWPayments. This seamless integration allows for instant product delivery while ensuring that creators maintain full ownership of their data and digital assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions affected by payment restrictions. Whether you are selling ebooks, software, or online courses, this architecture provides a sovereign solution tailored to your needs. Unlike mainstream platforms that impose high fees and restrictions, this model empowers you to retain a larger share of your revenue. By reducing transaction fees from around 10% on platforms like Gumroad to just 0.5% with NOWPayments, creators can significantly increase their profitability.
Reduce transaction fees from 10% to just 0.5% with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The no-KYC payment system is composed of several integral components. Hosting your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages offers reliable uptime and free hosting. Utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic allows for efficient order processing and payment verification. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction fees. Each piece of this stack works in harmony to create a seamless and self-sufficient digital commerce environment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your no-KYC digital product store, start by choosing your hosting service. Next, configure your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept multiple currencies. Finally, populate your store with your digital products and test the payment flow. For a comprehensive guide and templates, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to get started.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a no-KYC payment processor like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, eliminating the need for traditional banking services. By leveraging platforms like Cloudflare for hosting and automated delivery systems, you can create a fully functional digital product store that keeps your revenue intact.
Leverage free hosting options to keep your overhead costs low.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads exclusively through cryptocurrency and without platform fees, you can explore our Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to establish your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by creating a digital product store using NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency. This approach bypasses the need for traditional payment platforms and allows you to retain full control over your sales process.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is by utilizing a sovereign commerce stack that leverages tools like Cloudflare for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, significantly reducing costs.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip by setting up your own store with a no-KYC payment processor. This gives you complete ownership and control over your sales.
What are the benefits of using a no-KYC payment processor?

Using a no-KYC payment processor like NOWPayments offers several benefits, including lower transaction fees, no customer account requirements, and the ability to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies.
How do I ensure automatic delivery of my digital products?

To ensure automatic delivery, you can implement Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order fulfillment. This setup allows buyers to receive their products immediately after payment confirmation.
Retain full ownership of your customer data and sales process.
